goals: Verify that the ABS function correctly calculates the absolute value for different input data types including Scalar, Vector, and OrderedPair
activities: Execute the ABS function with a Scalar input of -1.0
Assert that the resulting x value is -1.0
Assert that the resulting y value is 1.0
Create a Vector using a numpy array of values from -10 to 9
Execute the ABS function with the Vector input
Assert that the resulting x values match the input vector values
Assert that the resulting y values match the absolute values of the input vector
Create a numpy array x of values from -10 to 9
Create a numpy array y of values from -20 to 19
Execute the ABS function with an OrderedPair created from arrays x and y
Assert that the resulting x values match the input x array
Assert that the resulting y values match the absolute values of the input y array
